checkpoint_selection.selection_evidence: Only the four inner folds belonging to the outer-training pool.
checkpoint_selection.same_held_fold_view: Preregistered diagnostic only; never promotion-eligible or package-eligible.

production.test_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all five logical fold contributions
production.fold_weight_source: fold h's inner grouped selector; never fold h target or protected outer score
production.zero_weight_fold: Contributes protected v20 exactly; physical candidate checkpoint may be omitted while the logical contribution remains in the five-way mean.
production.oof_limitation: Each labeled well has one leakage-free outer member prediction, so OOF does not directly measure the variance reduction of averaging five members on test.
